setup.parameters: hbar>0, chi>0, c>0, g>0, lambda>0, r real, fixed block origin, and constant energy-source J in R8
setup.coarse_geometry: even rectangular subsets of Z3 for the open auxiliary family and even periodic cubes Lambda_L=(Z/LZ)^3 for the registered family
setup.hamiltonian: H_L(J)=sum[-hbar^2/(2chi) d^2+r psi^2/2+g psi^4/4-J_epsilon psi]+(c/2) sum spatial difference squares+(lambda/4) sum onsite Q3-edge (psi_epsilon-psi_eta)^2(psi_epsilon^2+psi_eta^2)

fixed_lattice_theorem.finite_volume: Every finite open or periodic Hamiltonian is lower bounded, has compact resolvent and has finite heat trace for every beta>0.
fixed_lattice_theorem.open_limits: Open rectangular dimensionless log-partition and ground-energy densities have finite limits as all even side lengths tend independently to infinity.
fixed_lattice_theorem.periodic_limits: The even periodic-cube limits exist and equal the open limits for every beta>0 and every constant J.
fixed_lattice_theorem.source_regularities: At fixed beta the limiting log density and pressure are finite, locally uniform in J, convex and globally Z2-even; the ground density is finite, locally uniform, concave and globally Z2-even.
fixed_lattice_theorem.zero_temperature: For every compact J set and beta_star>0, 0<=e_L(J)-f_L(beta,J)<=C/(beta) uniformly in L and in open or periodic boundary condition for beta>=beta_star. Hence both iterated limits and every joint L,beta to infinity scalar path give e_infinity(J)=-lim pi_infinity(beta,J)/beta.
fixed_lattice_theorem.boundary_rate: The direct global-form comparison gives periodic-minus-open ground and fixed-beta free-energy density O(L^(-1/2)); no O(surface) total estimate is claimed.

proof_spine.stability: With Q=(g/8) sum psi^4, source Young absorption gives H_open(J)>=K-b_J |Lambda| where K=sum[-hbar^2/(2chi)d^2+(g/8)psi^4] and b_J is locally bounded in J.
proof_spine.volume_bounds: A fixed centered product Gaussian gives an explicit O(volume) variational upper bound, while min-max comparison with the product quartic oscillator gives an O(volume) heat-trace upper bound.
proof_spine.open_additivity: Deleting crossing spatial difference-square bonds lowers the Hamiltonian. Min-max eigenvalue ordering, not operator monotonicity of the exponential, makes ground/free energies superadditive and log partition functions subadditive; even-box tiling gives the open limits.
proof_spine.seam_absorption: For the 24L^2 periodic seam bonds, B_L<=eta Q+288c^2 L^2/(eta g). Since Q<=H_open+b_JL^3 as forms, H_periodic<=(1+eta)H_open+eta b_JL^3+288c^2L^2/(eta g). Min-max and eta=L^(-1/2) identify the periodic and open densities.
proof_spine.zero_temperature_squeeze: For beta>=beta_star, Tr exp[-beta(H-E0)]<=Tr exp[-beta_star(H-E0)]. Linear E0 and log-Z bounds therefore give the uniform C/beta difference between ground and free-energy densities.

centering_and_reference.source_free_center: At J=0, sigma=r_minus^2/(4g) per fine oscillator and H_hat=H+sigma*n_L is nonnegative.
centering_and_reference.source_boundary: For J not equal to zero this inherited scalar remains an additive convention but no longer makes H_hat(J) nonnegative.
centering_and_reference.physical_boundary: Adding any scalar d*n_L shifts pressure and energy densities while leaving normalized finite-volume Gibbs states unchanged. The center is not a physical empty-space selection and proves no below-empty-space inequality.

effective_reduction_split.collective_coordinates: At one coarse cell write psi_epsilon=Q/sqrt(8)+r_epsilon with sum r_epsilon=0.
effective_reduction_split.consequence: The natural collective/transverse tensor Hamiltonian is not additively split even before the Q3 lock is integrated. The finite classical collective restriction therefore does not establish a quantum marginal or a 3D-to-1+1 effective parent map.
effective_reduction_split.boundary: This reuses only the registered bare-restriction and ground-projectivity no-gos. Dressed embeddings, constraints, decoupling limits, mean-force maps and controlled RG reductions remain open.
